management_remarks: ICICI Bank started FY26 on a strong footing with Q1 FY26 Net Interest Income growing 11.8% year-on-year and consolidated Return on Equity maintained at 17.6%. Granular deposit inflows accelerated across affluent and salaried customer segments, strengthening our Liquidity Coverage Ratio and funding stability. Our technology investments in AI-powered credit underwriting and straight-through digital lending continue to improve cost-to-income efficiency.
analyst_qa: Responding to queries on repo rate transmission, immediate EBLR loan repricing creates near-term headwinds for NIM while term deposit repricing is slower and more challenging. We remain calibrated in unsecured retail lending as household leverage recovery is still uncertain in lower-ticket cohorts. Wholesale funding spreads remain volatile, keeping our treasury positioning cautious.
